room.drowned_lantern.title: The Drowned Lantern
room.drowned_lantern.description: The inn is low and warm and smells of peat smoke and spilled ale. The hearth is big enough to stand in. The [rumor board](rumor_board) is thick with pinned notes, and Maud’s bar runs along the back wall.
room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing, and the river slides past it the color of strong tea. A mooring post leans into the current with a [notice](notice) nailed to it. Tide marks stripe the pilings.
room.reed_path.title: Reed Path
room.reed_path.description: A narrow path presses south between tall reeds. Mud darkens the edges, where [fox prints](fox_prints) cross the path and vanish among the stems. The landing lies north.
detail.fox_prints.description: Small paw prints cross the soft mud, clear at the path's edge before the reeds swallow them.
detail.fox_prints.title: Fox prints
readable.fox_prints: The prints are small and close-set. They turn into the reeds; following them by sight ends at the first pool of dark water.
room.reed_bank.title: Reed Bank
room.reed_bank.description: The path reaches a low bank above brown fen water. [Tracks](tracks) mark the damp earth near the reeds. Firmer ground bends west under the willows. A firm path leads south to the mire crossing.
detail.tracks.description: The marks run along the bank and disappear into trampled reeds. The soft ground holds no clear story of who made them.
detail.tracks.title: Tracks
readable.tracks: Several narrow marks cross the bank toward the water. Wet reeds hide where they continue.
room.willow_shade.title: Willow Shade
room.willow_shade.description: Long willow branches hang over a strip of firm ground. The reed bank is east; south, the path passes beneath a great old oak.
room.drowned_oak.title: Drowned Oak
room.drowned_oak.description: A broad oak stands in dark water, its lower trunk silvered by old flood marks. The ground is still firm beneath its roots, and the willow path leads north. A firm bank leads east to the mire crossing.
room.inn_attic.title: Inn Attic
room.inn_attic.description: Dust lies thick as felt. A trunk with an iron hasp sits under the slope of the roof.
room.inn_rooms.title: Inn Rooms
room.inn_rooms.description: A narrow passage of doors under the eaves. One stands open on a bed made up tight, and a window over the green. The ceiling sags a little at the end of the passage.
room.lantern_cellar.title: Lantern Cellar
room.lantern_cellar.description: Ale casks lie on their sides in cradles. The floor is gritty, and the air tastes of old beer. Rat holes gnaw the base of every wall.
room.well_lane.title: Well Lane
room.well_lane.description: A cobbled lane climbs from the landing toward the green. In the middle stands the well, with a bucket on a chain. The Drowned Lantern’s sign creaks to the east.
item.brass_key.room: A small [brass key] lies here, its narrow tooth glinting.
item.brass_key.description: A small brass key with a narrow tooth.
item.wool_cloak.room: A [wool cloak] hangs over the bedpost.
item.wool_cloak.description: Heavy grey wool. Rain runs off it.
item.trunk.room: An old [trunk] sits under the slope of the roof.
item.trunk.description: An old wooden trunk. Its iron hasp is dark with age.
item.tin_whistle.room: A small [tin whistle] lies in the trunk.
item.tin_whistle.description: A small tin whistle, dulled by dust.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty, and a market cross of weathered stone marks the middle.
room.north_gate.title: North Gate
room.north_gate.description: The north gate is oak banded with iron, set in the village wall. North, a track climbs to the priory.
room.chapel_steps.title: Chapel Steps
room.chapel_steps.description: Wide stone steps, worn into dips, climb to the chapel door. An alms bowl sits on the top step.
room.chapel_nave.title: Chapel Nave
room.chapel_nave.description: The nave is cold and high. A fresco covers the east wall, and the altar is plain stone.
npc.cellar_rat.description: A small grey rat watches from beside a barrel, its whiskers twitching.
npc.cellar_rat_1.room: A [[cellar_rat_1|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_2.room: A [[cellar_rat_2|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_3.room: A [[cellar_rat_3|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_4.room: A [[cellar_rat_4|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_5.room: A [[cellar_rat_5|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
combat.player_hit: Your blow strikes the rat squarely.
combat.player_miss: The rat darts clear of your blow.
combat.npc_hit: The rat sinks its teeth into you.
combat.npc_miss: The rat snaps at you, but finds only air.
combat.player_died: You crumple to the floor. You awaken at the shrine.
combat.npc_died: The rat gives one last shudder and lies still.
npc.maud.room: [Widow Maud] is here behind the bar, wiping a mug that is already clean.
npc.maud.description: Broad, floury, sharp-eyed. She has been widowed by the river and has not forgiven it.
dialogue.maud_offer.prompt: “Clear the five rats out of my cellar and I’ll give you the key to the storage chest upstairs.”
narration.maud.accept: You agree to clear Maud’s cellar.
dialogue.maud_turn_in.prompt: “Well? Have you dealt with those rats?”
narration.maud.done: Maud sets an iron key in your palm. “For the storage chest upstairs. You’ve earned it.”
quest.mauds_cellar.title: Maud’s Cellar
quest.mauds_cellar.active: Clear the five rats from the Lantern cellar.
quest.mauds_cellar.ready: The five cellar rats are dead. Return to Maud at the Drowned Lantern.
quest.mauds_cellar.resolved: You cleared Maud’s cellar and received the storage key.
item.cellar_key.description: An iron key, its bow worn smooth.
item.storage_chest.description: A wooden chest with an iron lock.
detail.notice.description: A weathered notice is nailed to the mooring post.
detail.rumor_board.description: Two notices are pinned to a wooden board beside the bar.
readable.notice: Keep the landing clear. Tie boats to the mooring post.
detail.rumor_board.title: Notice board
detail.lost_whistle.title: Lost tin whistle
detail.lost_whistle.description: A small handwritten notice asks about a missing whistle.
detail.cellar_help.title: Help in the cellar
detail.cellar_help.description: A notice from Maud asks for help below the inn.
readable.lost_whistle: Lost a tin whistle? Ask at the Drowned Lantern.
readable.cellar_help: Maud needs help clearing rats from the cellar. Speak to her at the bar.
detail.notice.title: Landing notice
npc.elspeth.room: [Elspeth] stands beside the mooring post, watching each boat come in.
npc.elspeth.description: A woman in a worn shawl keeps turning toward the river. One hand worries the edge of her sleeve; her eyes search every face on the landing.
dialogue.elspeth.prompt: “My boy Wren hasn’t come home. I keep thinking the next boat might bring word of him.” She gathers herself. “You’re new to Ashmere, aren’t you?”
narration.elspeth.directions: “North from here, up Well Lane,” Elspeth says. “Keep going north and you’ll reach Village Green. That’s the heart of Ashmere.”
narration.elspeth.inn: “Go north to Well Lane, then east into the Drowned Lantern. Maud keeps the inn. Speak to her at the bar; she’ll tell you what needs doing.”
narration.elspeth.wren: “My son.” Elspeth looks back at the river. “He’s always off exploring, but he should have been home by now.”
item.fox_drawing.room: A folded [fox drawing] lies near the elm's roots.
item.fox_drawing.description: A child's charcoal drawing shows a fox among tall reeds. The paper is creased and muddy. There is no name on it.
dialogue.elspeth.accept: Will you look around the Green for a sign of Wren?
narration.elspeth.accept: You agree to look around Village Green for a sign of Wren.
dialogue.elspeth_report.prompt: Elspeth watches the folded drawing in your hand.
dialogue.elspeth_report.report: I found this drawing on the Green.
narration.elspeth.report: “That could be Wren's drawing,” Elspeth says. “He was always exploring. The reeds south of the landing may be worth searching, but I can't know where he went.” “Look closely at the tracks on Reed Bank,” Elspeth says. “Follow them south. Wren is still missing.”
quest.first_lead.title: The First Lead
quest.first_lead.active: Look for a sign of Wren on Village Green.
quest.first_lead.ready: You found a fox drawing. Bring it to Elspeth at Ferry Landing.
quest.first_lead.resolved: Elspeth thought the drawing might be Wren's and suggested searching the reeds south of the landing.
quest.first_lead.failed: You could not follow the first lead.
quest.first_lead.abandoned: You set aside the search for a sign of Wren.
room.mire_crossing.title: Mire Crossing
room.mire_crossing.description: A narrow [plank](plank) spans the deepest mud. Firm banks lead north to the reeds and west beneath the old oak; the path continues south.
room.fox_hollow.title: Fox Hollow
room.fox_hollow.description: The path ends at a sheltered [hollow](hollow) among the reeds. Wren sits beside a foxlike stranger beneath the roots. The firm path returns north across the mire.
detail.plank.title: Plank
detail.plank.description: The plank is worn but steady, with a dry line across the mire.
readable.plank: The plank is worn but steady, with a dry line across the mire.
detail.hollow.title: Hollow
detail.hollow.description: Flattened grass and old fox bones mark a place where something has rested.
readable.hollow: Flattened grass and old fox bones mark a place where something has rested.
quest.missing_child.title: The Missing Child
quest.missing_child.active: Elspeth asks you to search for Wren. Study the tracks at Reed Bank, south of the landing.
quest.missing_child.lead: The tracks lead south across Mire Crossing toward Fox Hollow. Wren remains unfound.
quest.missing_child.resolved: Wren chose to remain with Vesper at Fox Hollow. You delivered Vesper’s message to his mother, Elspeth.
quest.missing_child.failed: The search for Wren has failed.
quest.missing_child.abandoned: You left the search for Wren.
narration.study_tracks: You kneel beside the tracks. Small footprints run south across the mire toward Fox Hollow. They give you a lead, but Wren remains unfound.
npc.wren.room: [Wren] sits among the roots beside Vesper.
npc.wren.description: A small boy with muddy knees holds a reed between his fingers. He watches the fox-faced stranger with open curiosity.
npc.vesper.room: [Vesper] waits beside the hollow, a russet tail curled around his feet.
npc.vesper.description: A slender figure in a russet coat stands beneath the roots. His pointed face and bright amber eyes are unmistakably foxlike.
dialogue.a_vesper_meeting.prompt: “You followed the tracks,” the stranger says. “I am Vesper. And this is Wren.” The boy looks up at his name.
dialogue.a_vesper_meeting.meet_wren: “Wren, your mother is looking for you.”
narration.a_vesper_meeting: Wren nods. “I know. Vesper was showing me the fox paths.” You have found him alive, here in the hollow.
dialogue.b_vesper_riddle.prompt: Vesper lays out letter tiles. “I carry a flame behind glass. Held in a hand, I guide a traveller through darkness. What am I?”
narration.vesper_wrong: Vesper shakes his head gently. “Try the letters again. Think of the light a traveller carries.”
narration.b_vesper_riddle: “A lantern. Well answered,” Vesper says. Wren smiles. The question of returning to Elspeth still waits.
dialogue.c_vesper_answered.prompt: “You have answered my riddle,” Vesper says. “Wren wishes to stay here with me. Will you carry this message to his mother at the landing?”
narration.c_vesper_answered: Vesper places his folded message in your hand. Wren stays beside him. You agree to take the message to Elspeth at Ferry Landing.
dialogue.vesper.prompt: The foxlike stranger watches you from beside the hollow.
narration.vesper: “The firm path runs north,” the stranger says. “There is no need to wait for the tide.”
dialogue.wren.prompt: The boy looks up from the reed in his hands.
narration.wren: “Vesper knows every fox path,” Wren says. “You can talk to him.”
quest.missing_child.met: You met Wren alive at Fox Hollow. Speak to Vesper and answer his letter-bank riddle. Wren has not returned home.
quest.missing_child.answered: Vesper accepted your answer. Wren is still at Fox Hollow; the decision about returning to Elspeth remains pending.
item.vesper_message.description: A folded message addressed to Elspeth in a fine, slanting hand. Vesper entrusted it to you for Wren’s mother.
dialogue.c_vesper_answered.carry_message: “I’ll take your message to Elspeth. Wren can stay.”
dialogue.elspeth_return.prompt: Elspeth looks at the folded message. “You have news of Wren?”
narration.elspeth_return: Elspeth accepts Vesper’s message and reads it slowly. “He has chosen to stay,” she says. “Thank you for bringing me his word.” Wren remains with Vesper at Fox Hollow.
dialogue.elspeth_stays.prompt: Elspeth folds the message carefully. “I know where Wren is now. He has chosen to stay with Vesper.”
narration.elspeth_stays: “I will keep his message,” Elspeth says. She tucks the folded paper safely inside her shawl.
quest.missing_child.deliver: Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper. Deliver Vesper’s original message to Elspeth at Ferry Landing; if you left it behind, recover it first.
room.village_green.stays: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered market cross. Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper; his message has reached his mother.
